pages.text: Every Akaishi trinket runs on the same shared machinery:$(li)each effect drains its own internal energy buffer first$(li)when the buffer runs dry, the trinket sips power from the $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cells$(/l) in your inventory$(li)carry one cell and the whole set stays alive on the go$(br2)They split into three roles, each with its own entry: $(l:akaishi:curios_income)Fortune Trinkets$(/l) drop crystals, $(l:akaishi:curios_defense)Defense Trinkets$(/l) shrug off damage, $(l:akaishi:curios_survival)Sustain Trinkets$(/l) feed you and cure debuffs.

$(bold)Slot map (Curios):$(0)$(li)rings -> ring$(li)bracelets -> hands$(li)pendants -> necklace$(li)charms -> charm$(li)chest trinkets -> body$(li)bangles -> bracelet$(li)waist trinkets -> belt$(br2)Wrong slot? It won't equip. Check which slots you have unlocked before you wear anything.

$(bold)Akaishi extension slots:$(0) as your Akaishi progress advances, four extra slots grow on your body. All four names are masked by gibberish (they flicker in-game and cannot be read), so tell them apart by the icon colour at the bottom of the slot: red / gold / green / aqua map to slots one through four.$(br2)Thresholds are counted in completed nodes on the Akaishi Path advancement tree: slot one needs 1 node, slot two needs 2, slot three needs 3, slot four needs 4.$(br2)Tune each threshold under the "Akaishi curio extension slots" config category; turn off "Extension slots require progress" to open all four at once.

$(bold)What these four slots are really for:$(0) they exist for the $(4)Forbidden$(0) trinkets. Each forbidden trinket maps to one slot colour —$(li)$(4)red$(0) -> Touch of a Thousand Hands$(li)$(4)gold$(0) -> Quickening of the Cub$(li)$(4)green$(0) -> The Mother's Gaze$(li)$(4)aqua$(0) -> Endless Gestation$(br2)None of the four comes from a crafting table. They can only be condensed by the $(4)Mother Altar ritual$(0), which needs a Tier 3 altar, 8 outer offerings and a large amount of life energy. For the full ritual, the offering list and the price of wearing them, see the "Forbidden Ritual" entry in Life's Secrets.$(br2)Think it over before you wear one — the boons are strong, and so is the cost.

The three group entries: $(l:akaishi:curios_income)Fortune$(/l) / $(l:akaishi:curios_defense)Defense$(/l) / $(l:akaishi:curios_survival)Sustain$(/l); the battery that keeps them going is the $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cell$(/l).
